_doc: Manager-owned HINTS for ~/.local/bin/hermes-dispatch-route. The model set comes from the gateway's live /models listing; this file only orders it. rank = general strength (escalation moves only to a strictly stronger flatiron model, else the next rung of the tier's fallback list below). routes = per-kind preference order. features[model] = {vision, web, probed}: probed capabilities; probed is the date of the last successful probe. The bare keys haiku/sonnet/opus describe the Claude fallback rungs. `pick KIND --needs f1,f2` keeps only models whose features entry has every named feature true (no entry = no capabilities); `pick vision` means `--needs vision`. sync probes features for new healthy listed models and ranks listed unranked models; entries for models the gateway no longer lists are ignored. floors maps kind to anchor model id. A new or returning model enters that kind only when at least as strong as the anchor. A missing floors entry closes code, debug, research or frontend to new models. prose and mechanical have no floor. An anchor out of the rank map closes that kind to new models.

capacity._doc: measured by concurrent tiny completions, highest level under 2x single-call latency

efforts._doc: the reasoning efforts each flatiron model accepts; source: the provider's own error text. A model with no entry takes the tier value unchanged; a rejected value becomes the nearest accepted value at or above it, else the highest accepted
